name: Greedy (Magic Weapon Quality)
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 9th; Price +2 bonus; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ability can be placed on light weapons and was designed to help spelljacks and others that can steal magic hoard just a little more stolen power. A greedy weapon can store a touch range or personal only spell that has been stolen.When stealing a spell or spell-like ability the wielder can choose to store it in the greedy weapon rather than in their own reservoir of power. Discharging the spell requires making a successful attack against a target with the weapon. Alternatively the wielder can deal 1d4 points of damage to themself in order to be the target of the stored spell. A character can only have one greedy weapon with a stored spell at a time, if a second greedy weapon would store a spell any other carried greedy weapons lose their own stored spells, this also occurs if a character picks up a second greedy weapon with a stored spell when they already possess one.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, creator must be able to steal spells or spell-like abilities
